prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE CLUB suit pip master belonging to the EXACT SAME playing-card design family as the supplied spade, which is a STYLE reference. Match its ornate Ming/Tang silk lotus painting, line weight, double antique-gold beaded perimeter, ivory-and-madder-red central lotus rosette, teal/verdigris leaves, curling gold stems, and ONE small round turquoise center jewel in a gold rim.
Recompose the ornament inside an unmistakable upright CLUB: exactly THREE ROUND LOBES, one large round lobe at top, one round lobe at lower left and one round lobe at lower right, clearly separated by inward notches; all join a central body and a short flared stem below. Rounded trefoil silhouette, NO sharp top point, no fourth lobe, not a spade. Lamp Black #21211F body exactly like the reference, retaining ample visible black negative spaces between ornaments. Central lotus rosette with the single turquoise jewel on the vertical centerline near the canvas center; paired teal foliage and red lotus buds fill the three round lobes in a balanced composition. A small lotus bud in the flared stem if space allows. All decoration contained within the gold outline.
Clean readable silhouette even when downscaled to 100 pixels tall. One club, bilateral balance, fully visible with generous transparent padding on every side, square canvas about 1254x1254 matching the reference scale. Actual transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no opaque background and no painted checkerboard. Crisp print illustration with restrained shading exactly like the reference. No spade, other symbols, card, border around the canvas, text, numerals, A, outside ornament, shadow, watermark, or 3D rendering. This is a reusable prototype for both an ace and smaller numeral pips.
